name: Frau Hilde Keller
line: Corrects your grammar, then gives you cake. In that order.

name: Tomasz Lindner
line: Makes the best Streuselkuchen in town and tells you so before you've taken a bite.

name: Rolf Brandt
line: Believes every problem can be solved with more mortar or less paperwork.

name: Mayor Gerhard Pfennig
line: Has cut eleven ribbons and zero budgets. Nobody remembers voting for him, including him.

name: Hassan Qureshi
line: Sells newspapers, phone cards and very strong opinions about the bus timetable.

name: Grace Okafor
line: Has been shocked by 230 volts four times and by her students far more often.

name: Priya Nair
line: Knows everyone's blood pressure and keeps every secret.

name: Dieter Mahlke
line: Has reported the same pothole 41 times. Keeps a folder. The folder has tabs.

name: Marta Nowak
role: night-shift carer at the care home
line: Works nights, raises two kids and is still the funniest person at the bus stop.

name: Leni Nowak
line: Wants a working swing and a pet dragon, in that order.

name: Amira Haddad
line: Knows every pothole in town by name and has opinions about each one.

name: Jens Voss
line: Has fished off the bridge since it was a whole bridge.

name: Benno
line: Chases delivery bikes. Has never caught one. Lives in hope.

name: Ravi Menon
line: Names every laptop he repairs. Yours is called Gustav.

name: Lotte Fink
line: The paper's only reporter, photographer and delivery person. Very fair. Very tired.

name: Mehmet Yilmaz
line: Has kept the school running for 22 years with gaffer tape and patience.

name: Kai Sturm
line: Has never been anywhere he didn't call ‘insane’.

name: Helga
line: Has escaped eleven times. Considers fences a suggestion.
